literature_notes: All six ledger lines (L1–L6) describe C-terminal fusions (EGFP, 1D4, HA, GFP-HA) on full-length membrane-anchored PLA2R1. The computed topology places the C-terminus (residues 1421–1463) in the intracellular compartment, and L5/L6 state this explicitly: L5 reads 'C-terminus of PLA2R's intracellular domain' and L6 reads 'targeting the C-terminal intracellular domain.' No ledger line reports a tag at the extracellular N-terminus (mature residue 21, after signal-peptide cleavage at 1–20), in any extracellular loop, or anywhere else on the extracellular face. Because the ledger contains no qualifying insertion on the extracellular surface, zero sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: GFP-HA (PGH construct) appended after the last residue of the intracellular C-terminal tail; L6 confirms the HA antibody detects only the membrane-retained fragment, not the shed ectodomain.
C-terminal HA tag on full-length hPLA2R1 expressed in T-REx-293 cells under tetracycline induction; tag is on the intracellular tail (residues 1421–1463).
C-terminal EGFP or 1D4 (TETSQVAPA) fusion on full-length human PLA2R; C-terminus is intracellular per topology.
